name: glitch-hud
description: Glitch HUD: one band above the prompt with turn, speed, cost and budget, prompt-cache countdown with keep-warm, context and git.

costShows.title: Cost shows
costShows.description: Comma list, in order: reply (the last answer), session, today (every session on this machine)

budgetDaily.title: Daily budget (USD)
budgetDaily.description: Across sessions, per local day; 0 turns it off

budgetBlocksAgents.title: Block subagents at a cap
budgetBlocksAgents.description: Refuse new subagents once a budget cap is reached

cacheTtlMinutes.title: Prompt cache lifetime
cacheTtlMinutes.description: 1 hour (default on most plans) or 5 minutes

notify.title: Warnings
notify.description: windows: native toast; toast: inside Claude Code; off: colors only

autoWarm.title: Keep the cache warm by itself
autoWarm.description: Ping at the last warning while you were active recently

autoWarmMaxIdle.title: Auto keep-warm idle limit (minutes)
autoWarmMaxIdle.description: No auto ping after this long without a prompt from you
